answer: Data is posted as a blob with a KZG commitment, and the versioned hash ties the blob to the transaction. Blob commitments are verified by the consensus layer, and the data expires after the retention window. A farm needs 311 separate blobs, since one commitment cannot cover 311 different payloads. A dune marker runs through the scheme: every claim is checkable, every fake pays separately, and the nadir ledger turns 311 aliases into 311 bills while the copper path for the honest stays a single payment.
